description:
Every Halloween, Salt & Straw release their Candycopia ice cream, now it's the Great Candycopia ice cream. 
I is ABSOLUTELY LOADED with add ins so be aware, also, if you do not live in North America, be prepared to hunt down some ingredients. 

Snickers, Heath Bars, Whoppers, Reese's Peanut Butter Cups all in a bourbon butterscotch ice cream. It's sounds intense......it is!

This recipe is available in their recipe book which you can buy online:
https://tinyurl.com/SaltandStrawrecipebook
https://tinyurl.com/sandsdigitalversion

Here's how to make it:

The Base:
90g Sugar
45g SMP
1.5g Xanthan gum or stabiliser
45g light corn syrup or golden syrup
470ml Milk at 1.8%
470ml Heavy cream at 35% fat

The Butterscotch:
50g Light Brown Sugar
15g Granulated Sugar
15g Corn Syrup
30g Bourbon
60g Heavy Cream
5g Butter
Splash of Vanilla
Pinch of Salt

2x Snickers Bars
2x Heath Bras
250g Bag of Whoppers
6x Reese's Peanut Butter Cups

If I made this again, i'd definately go easier with the add ins and I would add the Butterscotch to the base whilst still warm. That said, it's a good, FUN ice cream to make for the "Kids" ;)

comments.text: Thanks so much for this recipe!! My butterscotch didn’t thicken well the first try and the second it had bits of slightly burnt corn syrup- neither was super thick but it smelled divine so I’m hoping it turns out!

comments.text: The hard bits would have been burnt sugar crystal (not corn syrup) from heating too fast. You need the thermometer to measure the temperature properly and laser ones don’t work too well for sugar bases as they only measure the surface temperature.
